comparison.objective: Switch on a bench supply and turn its voltage knob from 12 V to 9 V; the candidate mechanically sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Button pressing and single-knob angular regulation from a displayed value, not simultaneous screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Supply on, voltage within 0.2 V, other controls undisturbed, arms clear, and 1 s stability; candidate additionally requires physical locking and three retained cycles.
comparison.reason: A knob setting without a coupled locknut does not test preserving a setting during tightening.
